question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c19927fcf8268b0c3c96b6b423ebab1d9d0430ef406dc65634852c97a01f0154.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

\When is mirror is placed vertically to the object, the mirror image will be laterally inverted. In other words, the** Left Hand Side **and** Right Hand Side** interchange their positions while top and bottom will remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e17db55083e7f6769fbde6f128c18b4877881f91f7b91f66526616a34b0e8d7.png]
